sections.title: Professional Internship in Counseling I
sections.description: The course will consist of experiential and small group learning, with a focus on practicing and refining skills related to advanced work in psychological services, including the application of various techniques of counseling, ethical considerations, and critiques of live and simulated counseling sessions through role-playing, audio and visual taping. Prerequisite: Formal admission into Professional Counseling and Psychology M. Phil. Program.
